title: Coffee flung EVERYWHERE
text: Coffee flung EVERYWHERE. I am totally done with Burg grinders. They are so static-y and fling coffee all over your counter no matter how careful you are. And this grinder was easy to use but again the amount of cleanup was horrible. I just can’t recommend it.
